interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Stop Sign Installation
interventions.description: Install a stop sign to clearly define right-of-way and slow traffic approaching the crosswalk.

result.summary: This residential one-way street features continuous sidewalks but lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the visible intersection. The absence of marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps, combined with parked vehicles obstructing sightlines at the corner, creates a challenging environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing point for pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb with no ramp, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the foreground

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: The silver minivan is parked very close to the corner, blocking the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street at the corner

interventions.title: Install ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corner to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: A narrow residential intersection featuring a faded crosswalk and no visible traffic control devices like stop signs or signals. Pedestrian safety is compromised by poor sightlines due to parked vehicles near the corner and a lack of accessible curb ramps.

hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are heavily worn, making the pedestrian crossing zone less visible to drivers.
